holidays.name: World Theatre Day
holidays.description: A global celebration of the performing arts, when theatres around the world dim the lights, raise the curtain, and remind everyone that drama is best experienced live (and preferably with overpriced snacks).
holidays.origin: Founded in 1961 by the International Theatre Institute (ITI) at the ITI World Congress in Vienna. Each year a prominent theatre figure writes an International Message, which is read in theatres worldwide.
holidays.funFact: The first World Theatre Day message was written by French playwright Jean Cocteau in 1962.

holidays.name: Quirky Country Music Song Titles Day
holidays.description: A day to celebrate the glorious absurdity of country music song titles, from heartbreak to pickup trucks to dogs, with humor and twang in equal measure.
holidays.origin: An unofficial, fan-driven observance listed in quirky holiday calendars, inspired by country music's long tradition of wonderfully punny and over-the-top song titles.
holidays.funFact: Real country titles include 'I've Got Tears in My Ears from Lyin' on My Back in My Bed While I Cry Over You' and 'How Can I Miss You If You Won't Go Away?'

holidays.name: Scribble Day
holidays.description: A day to put pen to paper and doodle without judgment. No talent required, and the more chaotic the squiggles, the better. Perfect for meetings that could have been emails.
holidays.origin: An informal creative observance that encourages people to embrace spontaneous drawing and play, popularized through online lists of fun and unusual days.
holidays.funFact: Studies have suggested that doodling can actually help people retain information, so scribbling during a boring lecture may be quietly boosting your memory.

holidays.name: Respect Your Cat Day
holidays.description: A day for humans to acknowledge their feline overlords. Respect the cat's schedule, its personal space, and its sacred right to knock things off tables.
holidays.origin: A lighthearted unofficial pet observance that encourages cat owners to better understand and honor their cats' body language and boundaries.
holidays.funFact: Cats have a specialized collarbone structure that lets them squeeze through any gap their head can fit through, which is why they always appear to be somewhere you didn't expect.

holidays.name: Take a Walk in the Park Day
holidays.description: An invitation to step away from screens and stroll through a park, breathing fresh air, greeting squirrels, and pretending you totally planned to be outdoors.
holidays.origin: An informal wellness observance that began circulating in calendars of fun national days, promoting outdoor activity and the mental benefits of nature.
holidays.funFact: Research has found that spending just 20 minutes in a natural setting can measurably lower stress hormone levels.
